title: SieveScript/query refuses RFC 8620 §5.5 operator trees (unsupportedFilter)
description: Found while implementing JMAP-skk9.2. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/sieve.rs:174 decodes SieveScript/query's filter into a private bare SieveScriptFilter {name, isActive}, so an AND/OR/NOT tree is answered unsupportedFilter. RFC 9661 SieveScript/query is a standard /query (RFC 8620 §5.5 line 2368: filter is FilterOperator|FilterCondition|null). Not a QueryObject, so out of scope for skk9.2. Fix: decode jmap_types::Filter<SieveScriptFilter> and evaluate with Filter::matches (added in 48222c26). Error, not wrong results, so low priority.
close_reason: batch 14d: committed, adversarially verified, CI green at ed08ab5d
